reference.title: AT+MHTTPCONTENT Set HTTP Content Data
reference.shortdesc: This command is used to set HTTP content data.

row.entry: If succeed: +MHTTPCONTENT: (list of supported <httpid>s),(list of supported <eof>s),(list of supported <length>s), OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>

If succeed:
<httpid> is configured only to query the configured data: [+MHTTPCONTENT: <httpid>,<length>,<data>] OK<eof> is configured while <length> and <data> are not. Send data by CTRL+Z, and cancel sending by ESC: >(input data) OK <length> is configured while <data> is not. Send data when input data reaches the specified length or timeout is reached: >(input data) OK All parameters set: OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>

Valid for a single request and automatically cleared upon request completion. If the <data> parameter is omitted in the configuration command, the module enters data mode, indicated by the > prompt for data input. In standard mode, configure the content data before using the AT+MHTTPREQUEST command to send request. In Chunked mode, use the AT+MHTTPREQUEST command to send request before using it to send content. In Chunked mode, using the command to send content after sending request and receiving the +MHTTPURC: "ind" reporting.

plentry.pd: The content input termination marker. Subsequent input is only permitted after the request completes or is cleared.
Subsequent content data input is pending.
Clear existing content data (only apply for non-Chunked mode).

row.entry:
<length>Data input length 0-4096. In data mode, setting to 0 is not permitted. When directly inputting data in command mode: If set to 0, no length validation is performed on the input data; If set >0, the system will validate the input data length. (For ASCII and escaped string input modes: The system shall validate whether the actual input string length in the command matches the specified length. For HEX string input mode: The system shall verify the actual input string length equals twice the specified length.)
MN327: In direct command input mode, the maximum length of a single command is 2048 characters; exceeding this limit will result in an error.
ML302S/ML307S/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307M/ML307H/ML307N/MR380R/MR380M: In data mode, this can be set to 0.
ML305U: In data mode, setting to 0 is permitted. The parameter defaults to 0 when the parameter is omitted.
ML307G: The supported maximum content length is 3*4096 bytes.

<data>Content data. Valid for a single request and automatically cleared upon request completion.
The <input_format> parameter configured via AT+MHTTPCFG="encoding" shall only apply to direct command input mode (where <data> is explicitly included in the AT command), and shall not affect data input mode (which uses raw data).
ML302S/ML307S/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML305U/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307M/ML307H/ML307N/ML307X/ML307Y: String parameters must not contain the quotation mark. To include quotation mark within string parameters, data mode transmission shall be used.
MR380M: The CONTENT field does not support consecutive double quotation marks or commas in input.

Set content data (data input included in the command) AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,0,"{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"}" OK Set content data (data input excluded in the command) AT+MHTTPCONTENT=0,0,70 >{"id":"speed1"\r,"tags":["mobile"],"unit":"m/s"\r,"unit_symbol":"m/s"} OK

note.div: M5310-E/MN327/MN328/MN318/MN316/MN319/MN319-A/MN326/MN316A/MN326A: The > data input mode is not supported, data must be input directly in the AT command. Single input length is limited by platform's single command constraints, thus, for larger data, multiple inputs are recommended.
MN319/MN319-A: The maximum length of AT command parameter is 1,560 bytes.
ML307X/ML307Y: The total writable data length shall not exceed 8,192 bytes.
ML307B: The maximum length of AT command parameter is 3,000 bytes.
